nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs when a workflow that has THIS workflow selected as its 'Error Workflow' (Workflow settings) fails. Select it in MAIN's settings; do not activate it separately.

nodes.name: Extract error info
nodes.notes: Normalises both Error Trigger shapes, redacts secrets (Google OAuth tokens, API keys, bearer tokens, passwords), clips lengths, ignores this handler's own errors.

nodes.name: Throttle alerts
nodes.notes: Per-error cooldown (15 min) + global cap (6 alerts / 10 min, then one storm notice). State lives in workflow static data.

nodes.name: Build alert message
nodes.notes: Admin address comes from $env.ADMIN_EMAIL; if empty, nothing is sent.

nodes.name: Send admin alert
nodes.notes: Gmail OAuth2 credential (the same one MAIN uses). onError=continueRegularOutput so a failed alert cannot raise another error.
